name: k8s factory — a ResourceQuota stays at or above 90% of hard in factory or factory-mi-homelab for 15 min
description: Fires, per namespace and constrained resource, when the LOWEST k8s.resource_quota.used / k8s.resource_quota.hard_limit ratio in the trailing 15 min is at or above 0.90: usage stayed at 90% the whole window. Covers pods, requests/limits CPU and memory of factory-runs and factory-mi-homelab-runs. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml, item livespec-dev-tooling-ec2rkp). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; kubectl get pods -n <namespace> -o wide; kubectl describe pod -n <namespace> <pod>; kubectl get events -n <namespace> --sort-by=.lastTimestamp. kubectl get pods -n <namespace> --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp; kubectl describe resourcequota -n <namespace>. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
